member.summary: Platform-side endpoint for LTI Dynamic Registration 1.0. See https://www.imsglobal.org/spec/lti-dr/v1p0/#registration-endpoint
member.remarks:
A request goes through three steps, in this order:
decides whether the caller may register (401/403 otherwise).
The body is read and checked by (400 invalid_client_metadata otherwise).
stores the registration and returns it with a new client_id (201).

member.name: M:LtiAdvantage.AspNetCore.DynamicRegistration.DynamicRegistrationControllerBase.OnRegisterAsync(LtiAdvantage.AspNetCore.DynamicRegistration.RegisterToolRequest)
member.summary: Stores the registration and returns the registered tool configuration with a newly assigned . The endpoint answers 201 Created with it.
member.remarks:
Called only after allowed the request and found no errors. Any client_id the tool sent has already been cleared, so the platform always chooses it.
To reject the registration, throw . It can also be thrown from and .
Returning null, or a configuration without a client_id, is a server error (500).

member.name: M:LtiAdvantage.AspNetCore.DynamicRegistration.DynamicRegistrationControllerBase.AuthorizeRegistrationAsync(System.String)
member.summary: Decides whether a registration request may proceed. Return null to allow it, or a result (such as Unauthorized()) to reject it.
member.remarks: Runs before the request body is read. The spec leaves the registration_token optional and opaque (DR §3.3), so platforms that issue their own tokens (for example single-use tokens stored in a database), or accept registrations without one, should override this method. The default authenticates the request with the scheme and requires the policy (registered by AddLtiAdvantagePolicies). If the scheme is not registered, every request is answered 401; if the policy is not registered, 403. Both log a warning.
member.param: The Bearer token from the Authorization header, or null when none was sent.

member.name: M:LtiAdvantage.AspNetCore.DynamicRegistration.DynamicRegistrationControllerBase.BearerUnauthorized(System.String)
member.summary: A 401 with the WWW-Authenticate: Bearer challenge required by RFC 6750 §3. When a token was sent it adds error="invalid_token"; when none was sent it adds no error code (§3.1).

member.summary: Checks the registration request for the metadata required by LTI Dynamic Registration 1.0 (§2.2 and §3.1). Returns one message per problem; an empty list (or null) means the request is valid. Override to add platform-specific rules (call the base method to keep the standard checks).

member.remarks: The ID of a resource link within the context. The result set will be filtered so that it includes only members that are permitted to access the resource link. member.name: P:LtiAdvantage.AspNetCore.NamesRoleProvisioningService.GetMembershipRequest.Role
member.summary: filter for members to return.
member.remarks: The result set will be filtered so that it includes only those memberships that contain this role. The value of the parameter should be the full URI for the role, although the simple name may be used for context-level roles. If omitted, the result set will include all members with any role.
